description: Complete session bundle — EVERY modality for one lesson in a single purchase: all 12 camera views (1080p MP4), BVH skeletal animation for both subjects (60 fps, 56-joint), and robot-ready NPZ joint trajectories for every supported platform (Unitree G1 43 DOF, Unitree H1 19 DOF, Apptronik Apollo 32 DOF). 20 files, ~$170 bought individually. Does NOT include the rigged FBX/OBJ mesh assets, which are licensed separately via Fab.com. Pay $50 USDC on Base (chain 8453, USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) to RTK wallet 0x6C11F8a21f7ca922F483Ed21C3b6c2d9B305B10C; pass tx hash as payment_tx. Solana USDC to 7vV3cV7iCtmwKCzK1tWRdbWop31zw7pVFe8HxfFKrTZV also accepted — pass the base58 signature as payment_tx. See /.well-known/x402.

lesson_path.description: Lesson path, e.g. 'BJJ/Training/KimuraFromSideControl/Lesson001'. Defaults to first available lesson. Use browse_catalog to list lessons and their bundle_price.

payment_tx.description: USDC transaction hash/signature. Send $50 USDC on Base to 0x6C11F8a21f7ca922F483Ed21C3b6c2d9B305B10C, or on Solana to 7vV3cV7iCtmwKCzK1tWRdbWop31zw7pVFe8HxfFKrTZV, then pass the tx hash (0x…) or base58 signature here.

quote_id.description: Redeem this item from a negotiated quote you already paid with pay_quote (q_...). Use instead of payment_tx / x_payment: no further payment is taken.

x_payment.description: Preferred on Base (x402 exact / gasless): base64 X-PAYMENT payload — a signed EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for $50 USDC to our wallet. Redeemable only by its signer; no gas needed. Solana must use payment_tx.
